channel.title: The AI Workshop
channel.description: An offline space for non-techies to put AI to work, one real use-case project at a time.

item.title: Build a Complete AI Video Ad From Scratch
item.description: Walk in with an idea. Walk out at 2:00 PM with a finished vertical ad: one face-locked character, 4 to 6 production stills, motion clips, and a natural voiceover, built on one repeatable prompt system. Three hours, offline, no filmmaking background required. Sunday, 27 September 2026, 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Salt Lake, Kolkata. 50 seats. ₹799.
